module_summary: Instruction register: fetch code selects which of two 8-bit registers loads data; outputs split ins_p1 into opcode and register address and expose ins_p2 as second address.

anchors.name: ins_p1
anchors.why: Instruction register from source 1; split into opcode ins and address ad1.

anchors.name: ins_p2
anchors.why: Instruction register from source 2 (RAM/ROM), output directly as ad2.

anchors.name: fetch
anchors.why: Load select: 01 writes data into ins_p1, 10 into ins_p2, else hold.

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: Incoming instruction byte loaded into either instruction register.

anchors.name: ins
anchors.why: Opcode field: upper 3 bits of ins_p1.

anchors.name: ad1
anchors.why: Register address field: lower 5 bits of ins_p1.

groups.name: field_split
groups.description: Splits stored instructions into opcode, register address and second address.
